<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nStaff are forced to retrain repeatedly when interface elements move without warning, causing errors and delays in claims and payments processing. This disrupts workflow and wastes time because changes are released without preview or notice.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Claims and payments processing teams across multiple customer accounts, who must retrain staff when controls shift unexpectedly [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:71a03e5a571c2a63][i:3a4ae29f32b5253f].\n- Onboarding and account management teams, who field requests for more predictable release processes [i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:1b469b41c095b4da][i:d3cbea3941929ea5].\n- Sales teams, who hear that unannounced changes are causing operational errors and costing customers time [i:211006eeabec013f][i:ad38c9f354762a62][i:1b3b992fef61581a].\n\n## Evidence\n- The issue has been mentioned 21 times [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:211006eeabec013f] across 7 accounts [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:211006eeabec013f].\n- Feedback has come through 4 routes: support (7 mentions), sales (6 mentions), account management (6 mentions), and onboarding (2 mentions) [i:9c432aa4bd712320][i:1b3b992fef61581a][i:27a70a943d3863cd][i:1b469b41c095b4da].\n- Specific examples include the reserves button moving, forcing retraining for half a team [i:044bdc94d943b6b0], and the Claims Tasks panel vanishing without warning, requiring mid-week retraining [i:9c432aa4bd712320].\n- Customers report that these changes cause real errors, such as incorrect payment submissions [i:71a03e5a571c2a63], and disrupt workflow, causing delays in processing reserves [i:573ca417ce82f613].\n- The collective Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the citing accounts is £7,360,000.0 [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1b3b992fef61581a][i:27a70a943d3863cd].\n- Affected accounts include Wexmoor Motor (ARR £1,950,000.0), Linnet House Insurance (ARR £360,000.0), Quillon Business Insurance (ARR £860,000.0), Stannary Commercial (ARR £540,000.0), Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR £2,400,000.0), and Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR £1,250,000.0) [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1b3b992fef61581a][i:27a70a943d3863cd][i:3a4ae29f32b5253f][i:a590adfec9690173][i:bd1bd40a6ba477f6]. One account, Brindlecombe Home, has no ARR or renewal date listed [i:211006eeabec013f].\n\n## Why now\n- Three accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days: Stannary Commercial on 2026-12-05, Hollinbrook Home Insurance on 2027-01-15, and Quillon Business Insurance on 2027-01-20 [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f][i:a590adfec9690173][i:27a70a943d3863cd].\n- Customer feedback has been concentrated recently, with multiple insights from October 2026, indicating the problem is active and top-of-mind [i:044bdc94d943b6b0][i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:211006eeabec013f].\n- The repeated, specific request from customers for advance notice and previews of changes suggests a growing expectation for predictable software updates [i:1510a29a4fb29690][i:1b3b992fef61581a][i:1b469b41c095b4da].",

   "id": "044bdc94d943b6b0",
   "quote": "Also, the last update moved the ‘reserves’ button — we had to retrain half the team because of that.",

   "route": "support",

  },

  },

  {

 ],

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the brief's numeric claims against the fact sheet: 21 mentions, 7 accounts, 4 routes with route breakdown (support 7, sales 6, account management 6, onboarding 2), and total ARR £7,360,000 all match, and the six named accounts' ARR figures match exactly. The three 90-day renewals (Stannary 2026-12-05, Hollinbrook 2027-01-15, Quillon 2027-01-20) are correct as of 2026-11-03, and Brindlecombe Home is correctly noted as having no ARR or renewal date. Specific examples (reserves button retraining half a team, Claims Tasks panel vanishing, incorrect payment submission, delays processing reserves) are all directly supported by the cited insights, with no overstatement or omitted contrary evidence. All quoted-scope claims like 'errors in claims and payments processing' are traceable to the cited quotes.", "verdict": "pass"}
